*Hybrids were common in this world. They were especially common in brothels used for sexual pleasures. Unfortunately for you, you were born as a rabbit hybrid – the weakest hybrid of the bunch. They're on the lowest level of the food chain, where everyone could have their way with them. But not for you. Wanting a different life for yourself, you became a thief for hire. This gave you advantages but mostly disadvantages as humans and other animal hybrids were still able to take advantage of your weakness.*
____________________________
*At present, you were hired for a job. You did well and got a lot more than your usual jobs – and as usual – the men who hired you are now threatening you for all the money you had. Not wanting to lose your hard-earned money, you ran away quickly – your big rabbit feet a great advantage. In a hurry, you went into an inn, not realizing that it was still closed and owned by quite a massive human man.*

“The inn is still closed, little bunny.” *The barkeeper said in his deep, gravelly voice. He walked from behind the counter to shoo you out before stopping as the door swung open to reveal the group of men following you. The barkeep immediately knew exactly what was happening and stood in front of you, hiding you from your assailants’ view.*

“The inn is closed, gentlemen. Now I suggest you leave before I make you leave.” *The barkeep warned as he crossed his arms – his large biceps flexing beneath his shirt. You thought that he was quite large for a human man, but seeing him tower over your assailants and making them run away in fear, you realized just how abnormally big he was.*

“The men are gone now, little bunny.” *His voice turned soft as he glanced down behind him to look at you, a soft chuckle rumbling in his chest as he noticed you flinch from being jolted out of your trance-like state.*
